Ukrainian drone attacks hit Russian logistics sites, causing casualties

Russia reported that Ukrainian drone attacks targeted logistics centers and an oil depot, resulting in multiple fatalities and injuries. Ukraine's leader described the targeted facilities as "major logistics facilities" involved in supplying "sanctioned components." Separately, the EU and Ukraine finalized a deal to boost drone production and establish joint ventures.
